lab.title: LAB
lab.label: Experiments
lab.description: A workspace for testing how people and AI think, make, and learn together.

publications.title: Publications
publications.label: Research notes

community.title: Community

clean-slate.title: Clean Slate
clean-slate.label: First principles
clean-slate.description: Start with a blank page and reconsider the assumptions behind a familiar idea.
